left.raw_text: Unresectable, histologically confirmed hepatocellular carcinoma with evident disease limited to liver.

right.raw_text: Tissue from tumor must be available.

left.raw_text: This may be paraffin embedded tissue from previous biopsy/resection

right.raw_text: or if it is not available, a repeat biopsy must be performed.

left.raw_text: alpha-fetoprotein is greater than 500 ng/mL and in the investigators opinion not explained by a concurrent hepatic inflammatory process.

right.raw_text: Patients must agree to have a 20 cc blood sample drawn in addition to routine labs with each cycle of chemotherapy.

left.raw_text: If prior radiation therapy was administered, measurable disease must be outside the radiation field.
Patients must have a Zubrod performance status of 0-2.

right.raw_text: Patients must have a predicted life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.

left.raw_text: Patients must have a pre-treatment granulocyte count (i.e., segmented neutrophils + bands) of greater than or equal to 1,500/mm3

right.raw_text: , a hemoglobin level of greater than or equal to 9 gm/dl
, and platelet count greater than or equal to 50,000/mm3.

left.raw_text: The granulocyte requirement may be waived if in the investigator's opinion the lower count reflects hypersplenism with adequate bone marrow reserves.
Patients must have adequate renal function as documented by a calculated creatinine clearance ≥ 60.
Patients must have adequate hepatic function as documented by a serum bilirubin less than or equal to 2x the institutional upper limit of normal
regardless of whether patients have liver involvement secondary to tumor.
